Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorDoorW: Allow Survivors to Open Doors and Windows
When disabled, survivors will not open closed doors or windows while pathing. They can still pass through already open or smashed openings and will report that permission is disabled when blocked.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseReading_toolti: Idle residents can read suitable carried books or borrow from assigned supplies. Uses normal reading, lighting, literacy and skill-level rules. Borrowed books are returned; needs, danger and new orders interrupt reading. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CautiousTravel_too: Survivors walk on ordinary supply, work and travel routes, crouching around visible nearby zombies while undetected. Escape and catching up with a running leader can still use faster movement. Turning this off restores distance-based jogging. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowAutonomousRet: Allows autonomous survivors, including travelling groups and base/faction residents, to use the normal bounded retreat decision when danger and a safe escape lane justify it. Player-owned companions remain governed by their orders. Turning this off does not disable combat, threat detection, group formation, traversal, or explicit player orders. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieEngagementDi: Maximum distance for automatically engaging an idle visible zombie. Default 4 tiles; lower values favor avoidance. Nearby attacks on themselves or allies still trigger defense within 8 tiles, and an existing fight can continue within 6. Aggressive companion orders retain their wider engagement range; base and group boundaries still apply. Hostile human encounters are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_OrderGestures_tool: Player orders use native Follow, Stop and Move Out gestures. Nearby free survivors can nod in acknowledgement. Gestures are rate limited and suppressed during combat, traversal and queued actions.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowRadialOrders: Show Knox Orders in Emote Radial
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowRadialOrders_t: Adds Knox companion, resident, and nearby-survivor actions to the vanilla emote radial. Turning this off leaves vanilla radial actions intact. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC: Show Knox Orders in Right-Click Menus

When enabled, adds Knox survivor, party, resident, and location order menus to right-click. When disabled, those right-click order menus are hidden; use the emote radial if it is enabled. Default off; the radial is enabled by default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR: Ignore Job Tool and Resource Requirements

Provides real tools and materials to survivors for supported base jobs, including barricading, without stocking storage first. Native actions still animate and consume the items; skills, valid targets and world rules still apply. Off by default. Provided items remain if this option is disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA: When enabled, your base and living companions continue under your next character and companions become base residents. The existing spouse stays with that household; the successor does not get a second spouse. When disabled, old player ownership remains unchanged.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithSpouse_to: A new character starts with one uniquely generated spouse companion nearby. Their identity and personality remain stable in that save. If your next character inherits your household, the existing spouse stays with it and no second spouse is created. Enable before starting a new character.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ToolCupboardCapaci: Compatibility setting for older saves that still contain a legacy Tool Cupboard policy. Current typed storage assignments use Build 42 native container capacity; this setting does not apply to them. Values are capped to each container's native limit, and changing capacity never deletes contents.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NpcDrivingSpeed_to: Maximum speed for NPC drivers. They slow further for turns and stopping distance. Requires NPC Driving.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorAimingAssi: Controls how readily survivors commit to a firearm and how long they settle their aim. Native Aiming skill and experience still determine shot accuracy, recoil and firearm effectiveness. Native Skills preserves the normal skill gap; Basic and Strong Assistance provide a more forgiving experience without granting skill XP.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental: Enables experimental Drive Ahead and right-click map driving orders while you are a passenger. Requires a running vehicle and a free driver seat or your companion already driving. Routes use nearby loaded outdoor ground (up to 160 tiles), with speed limits and obstacle braking. Towing is not supported. Off by default; native Build 42 driving acceptance is still pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Enabled_tooltip: Enables survivor gameplay systems. Existing survivor save data is preserved when disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_WorldPopulation_to: Persistent survivors distributed across the whole map. The balanced default is 48: uncommon enough to matter, but numerous enough to encounter while exploring. Most remain off-screen until their area is active.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupChance: Chance that nearby starting survivors form a small travelling group when the world is first populated. Groups are still limited by nearby origins.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupMaxSiz: Maximum size of a group formed from nearby starting survivors. This does not change the total world population.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupCount_: Maximum number of compact survivor groups formed when the world is first populated. Groups still require nearby origins and the configured group chance. Does not change total population.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DisableSurvivorCap: Ignores the active-survivor and companion limits. World Population still sets the starting population, but one new survivor may arrive each refill interval even above that number. Arrivals still require unused world locations and safe spawning; bodies load gradually. Faction ownership still applies. Large populations can reduce performance. Off by default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxActiveSurvivors: Maximum number of survivor bodies simulated near players at one time. Other survivors remain safely stored in the save. Higher values make encounters more likely but cost more performance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda: Maximum new survivor bodies loaded during one population update. Higher values help nearby groups appear together but can cause a short performance spike.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PopulationRefillDa: In-game days between replacement survivors, or new arrivals when survivor caps are disabled. Set to 0 for a finite starting population with no routine replacements or arrivals. Existing people remain, and separate Knox Events have their own controls. Re-enabling refill starts a full interval; missed arrivals never accumulate.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MinimumSpawnDistan: Minimum distance in tiles from every local player when a survivor appears for the first time. Survivors must also be out of sight, preventing visible pop-in.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorEncounterD: How close a persistent survivor must be before their body can be loaded into the world. Larger values use more active-survivor slots; spawning still requires a hidden safe square. The effective distance is at least 10 tiles beyond Minimum Survivor Spawn Distance so those settings cannot prevent all first appearances.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerFormation_: Preferred positions behind a leader for companions and travelling survivor groups. Paired places two followers in each row; Single File forms a narrower, longer column. Obstacles and native pathfinding may break the formation. This does not control vehicles or combat positioning.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerSpacing_to: Grid spacing between preferred follower positions, from 1 to 3 tiles per axis. Larger values spread the group out and place rear members farther behind. Blocked positions still use ordinary nearby-tile recovery. Default 1 preserves the existing close formation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CompanionLimit_too: Maximum number of active companions each local player can recruit.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowNPCFactions_t: Allows survivor groups to form factions and establish bases. Existing factions are not removed when disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo: Lets autonomous NPC factions create practical guard, patrol, farming, wood, corpse, and storage areas at their own bases. Player base areas remain manually controlled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents_t: Allows scripted faction and named-world events to dispatch. Off by default. Existing event records are preserved.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM: Survivors Needed to Form a Faction
Number of survivors a travelling group needs before it can become an NPC faction. Members must still build familiarity through shared survival. Default: 4.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMaxMembe: Maximum number of survivors an NPC faction can normally recruit. The effective limit is never below Survivors Needed to Form a Faction. Existing members are never removed when this is lowered.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowHostileEncoun: Allows independent survivors to threaten or rob one another when they meet.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowFactionRaids_: Allows established hostile NPC factions to send real members and equipment against another existing base. Off by default. Disabling this stops new automatic raids; an active party still returns safely.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidMinimum: Earliest world day when an established hostile faction can automatically plan a raid.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidInterva: Minimum number of in-game days between automatic raid scheduling checks. Only one automatic raid can be active at a time.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowCompanionHUD_t: Shows the right-side status panel while you have companions.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowActivityFeed_t: Shows the small Knox Survivors message feed. Survivor speech bubbles are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorSpeech: Shows survivor speech bubbles and spoken lines in the activity feed.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorNamepl: Shows player-style names above survivors you can currently see.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorNameplateD: Maximum distance in tiles for visible survivor names. Line of sight is still required.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye: Allows hostile survivors and players to fight one another. Relationship and hostility rules still apply.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_UseReputation_tool: Survivors judge you by trust earned through talk, gifts, help and fights. Low reputation blocks recruiting. Turn off to recruit on contact rules alone. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea: Allows nearby owned companions and base residents with a bandage to treat the bleeding player when they are idle and safe. Active jobs and combat remain higher priority.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDeveloperToo: Adds testing commands to the Knox Survivors world context menu. Disabled by default and not intended for normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperScenario_: Optionally creates a repeatable test population when the save loads. Manual spawn commands remain available from the world context menu.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperSpawnDist: Minimum distance in tiles used when placing test survivors around the player.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowDestructiveDe: Allows developer tests that can smash windows or alter the test area. Keep disabled on saves you care about.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDeveloperDiagn: Writes detailed test state to the game console and Knox logs. Disabled by default because this is only useful during focused testing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseCooking_toolti: Residents cook suitable ingredients from assigned supplies in an empty powered microwave, then store meals. Uses native cooking and automatic shutoff. Optional Cooking areas limit appliance selection and can be outside the base. Ovens, campfires and recipe preparation are not supported yet. Default on.
